governed_construct: A Cytoscape instance created inside a component lifecycle (a call to the default export of the 'cytoscape' package, under whatever local name it is bound by import or require, inside a React useEffect/useLayoutEffect callback or a class componentDidMount), together with the event listeners registered in that same lifecycle (on the instance via cy.on, or on window/document via addEventListener). One instance = one such creation site.
interpretation: On unmount, every Cytoscape instance a component creates must be torn down by calling destroy() on it in the matching cleanup (the function returned from the effect, or componentWillUnmount), and every window/document listener added alongside it must be removed with removeEventListener. Listeners registered on the Cytoscape instance itself are released by destroy(), so explicit off() is optional; conversely off()/removeListener()/elements().remove() without destroy() does not count as cleanup. A missing cleanup, a cleanup that skips destroy(), or a cleanup that destroys the instance but leaves a DOM listener attached is VIOLATED. Whether a call creates a Cytoscape instance is decided by binding: the callee must resolve to the 'cytoscape' package's default export, whether imported as `cytoscape`, under an alias, or via require; a file that creates no Cytoscape instance is NOT_APPLICABLE even if it mentions Cytoscape in comments or manages unrelated listeners.
